description: Bus Lanes is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. Bus lanes are sign-posted or marked as bus lanes. They are provided primarily for buses, but can also be used by: \ Taxis \ Hire cars (but not rental cars) \ Motorcycles and bicycles \ Emergency vehicles \ Special purpose vehicles and vehicles also operated by or under the direction of TfNSW Roads and Waterways ... Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are bus, bus lane, bus lanes, buses, lane. It offers 2 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2025-03-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
